scene.note: The functions that read the log move into one module, and the report and the radio desk both import it.

steps.note: The reading functions sit at the top of the report, where nothing else can use them.
They move into callouts.py, with every function they call, so the module makes sense on its own.
The report imports them from the module, and prints the same lines as before.
Importing the module runs its top lines, so Ailsa's try-out lines land in the middle of the report.
The try-out lines go under a guard that asks whether this file is the one that was run.
Imported, the module now only makes its functions; run by itself, it still tries them.
The month's lines and one hill go into a new function of the module.
Each line on that hill adds its hours, read by the functions already in the module.
The report imports it and tells Rhona the hours spent on that hill.
